risk_note: RV2 by path (admin-adjacent order sync, contract). Makes the manual sync limits honest: max_order_nos minimum goes from 1 to 0, where 0 means the platform has no sync by order number; manualSyncLimits gives 50 to MANUAL_SYNC_ORDER_NO_PLATFORMS and 0 to the rest, so jd reports 0 and pdd stays 50. The Jingdong order API queries by time window only, so no jd order-number sync is added. POST validation is unchanged and uses the same list. SyncDialog disables the by-number option when the chosen limit is 0 and returns to by-time when the platform changes, reading the limit value, never a platform name. No money or attribution.
